decisions.reason: As a newly launched, dedicatedly presented combination product, it is still an open option whose market value is not yet fully revealed and is worth keeping for another year.

This generic antidepressant faces stronger price and reimbursement pressure, but it still fits the firm's manufacturing capabilities and it is too early to exit without clearer evidence of weak uptake.
The antihypertensive combination tablet matches the firm's formulation and production strengths, and after only one year the uncertainty is still high enough to justify keeping it on the market.
The bone and joint supplement is a relatively low-cost option that supports the firm's strategy of building differentiated pharmacy health products outside reimbursement-dependent business.
